personal_info.name: Sama Al-Oda
personal_info.tagline: I build machine learning systems where software infrastructure, biomedical apps, and on-device intelligence meet — and I ship them.

education.degree: Bachelor of Software Engineering, Double Major with Biomedical Engineering

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineering Intern (CyberDome / R&D)
bullets: Productionized a real-time behavioral ML security system, debugging its C/eBPF telemetry layer and reducing anomaly alerts from 580+ alerts/s to approximately 1 alert/s with zero reported kernel-event loss.
Owned the system’s end-to-end MLOps lifecycle, automating builds, air-gapped packaging, testing, and deployment of distributed ML services across Kubernetes and OpenShift.
Built a secure observability pipeline connecting C/Python agents to enterprise SIEM systems, resolving networking, mTLS, and routing failures across four deployment configurations.

experience.title: Machine Learning & Software Developer Intern
bullets: Architected and deployed scalable cloud-based ML applications utilizing PyTorch and TensorFlow, engineering robust inference services through AWS-backed REST APIs to consistently achieve sub-200ms response latency.

Fine-tuned advanced transformer-based and computer vision architectures using Hugging Face, leveraging large-scale multimodal datasets to significantly enhance the accuracy and reliability of predictive analytical models.

Engineered robust cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android environments using Swift and Gradle, integrating CreateML, PostgreSQL, Supabase, and Firebase to support concurrent multi-user ML workflows.

Designed and implemented automated computer vision detection pipelines, facilitating high-throughput data analysis and accelerating the transition of complex research prototypes into reliable enterprise-grade software solutions.

projects.name: VALID: Multimodal Predictive AI
projects.description: Won the Responsible AI Award at CUCAI 2026 for leading a team of 10 to develop a multimodal ML framework for advanced decision support, achieving 91% precision and 88% macro-recall on complex datasets of over 120,000 unstructured text records. Architected a high-performance NLP pipeline using a BERT-based transformer for dynamic semantic label extraction, deploying the ensemble model (XGBoost, MLP, Random Forest) via a FastAPI RESTful gateway.

projects.name: Disaster Detection App
projects.description: Developed an iOS application leveraging on-device sensors and a disaster dataset API to detect hazardous events and trigger emergency alerts in real time with <5s detection latency. Integrated Twilio SMS services for instant notifications and implemented local data logging via caching to ensure offline reliability during critical events.

projects.name: KareBear: Full-Stack Interactive App
projects.description: Engineered a cross-platform mobile application using React Native and Expo, implementing full-stack integrations with Google Cloud APIs for real-time, low-latency audio and visual processing — earning 2nd place out of 100+ teams. Architected hardware-to-cloud communication pipelines, securely routing physical sensor data to a Gemini-powered conversational backend to generate dynamic, interactive system responses.
